description:
Mixed tenure residential redevelopment of the hospital site as follows:
a) the retention and conversion of Oakbrook Lodge as 8 flats (4 no.x1bed, 3no.x2bed and 1 no.x4bed), erection of 32 no. x3 bed three storey houses for market sale and the provision of 56 parking spaces in either integral garages or surface parking
b) the erection of 30 no. x 3 bed and 12 no. x4 bed three storey houses for rent and shared ownership, erection  of 1 no. x three storey block of flats, 1 no. x4 storey block of flats and 1 no.x5 storey block of flats to provide in total 34 no.x1 bed and 63 no.x2 bed flats for rent and shared ownership and the provision of 91 associated surface parking spaces.
c) the provision of 2 new vehicular accesses on to Goldhawk Road to replace the existing, three new pedestrian accesses onto Goldhawk Road and a new vehicular access off Ravenscourt Square and provision of estate roads and play area.
